parts.say: GTA 6 strip clubs charge 300 dollars for a private dance… and there's a NO REFUNDS sign.
[whispers] Look closer… there's even a notice: nobody under 21 allowed.
This car? An Obey Tailgater S. Check the badge… that's basically an Audi.
And the gun store? Customer parking only. You can buy a rifle… but parking here? That's where Rockstar draws the line.
Is GTA 6 too realistic? Comment below… and remember: no refunds.
